status: PARTIAL: W39 examples only; the canonical examples (1-12) wait on the canonical read
method: Direct viewing of the exported PNG sheets, plus scratch nearest-neighbour crops of the body (x3, with the ΔE panels re-amplified x4) that are not evidence. No browser.

readings.observation: Uniform colour, light inactive, 1x. Pre-W41's body is visibly lighter and greyer than native (its ΔE panel carries a flat grey interior). Now (E3) matches native's body level and olive hue: its interior ΔE is black even when re-amplified 4x further (ΔE x 32). Both web columns still lack native's dark contour just outside the path, so both carry the same bright outline in the difference panel; E3 does not change the edge.

Vertical grey gradient, light inactive, 1x. Pre-W41 shows horizontal bands across the body (ΔE x 8, visible without extra gain). Now removes most of them: at ΔE x 32 a faint banded residual remains in the upper half of the body and a thin line across the middle. The body follows native's gradient without new texture. The contour is missing on both web columns, the same as example 13.

distancesMeaning: Diagnostic only, not a referee. OKLab ΔE to native over the whole frame, and over the "changed" pixels (every pixel whose RGBA differs between pre-W41 and now). closerFraction is the share of changed pixels where now is nearer native.
